title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
title_zh: 大语言模型能通过自由探索发现隐藏的物理定律吗？

paragraphs.en: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws. Our project page and code are available.
paragraphs.zh: 科学发现往往始于一个意外的观察，这个观察引出新的研究问题。 在一个物理定律被改变的世界中，大型语言模型（LLMs）能否注意到意外行为，例如更重的物体下落得更慢，并在无人告知该研究什么的情况下，通过实验发现这一定律？ 为评估这一能力，我们提出 LongChang，一个自动化框架，它创建物理被改变的模拟世界，其中一条或多条定律与常规物理不同。 被评估的 LLMs 充当探索者，操纵物体并构建工具，以调查自己提出的问题，期间没有研究任务，也没有关于这些定律的提示。 另外的 LLM 智能体负责生成和审查场景、审查工具设计，并依据被改变的物理定律和探索记录评估报告的正确性与实验支持度。 这些记录引导场景演化以进行进一步探索，使整个循环无需人工干预即可运行。 在 12 个 LLMs 中，GPT-6-Astra 的发现率为 16.7%，而其他 11 个的发现率均为 0%。 探索记录揭示了尚未被调查的反常现象，以及对被改变物理定律仅部分的识别。 我们的项目主页和代码均已公开。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) aid scientific discovery through hypothesis generation, experiment design, and evidence analysis. Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. To pursue such inquiry autonomously, LLMs must decide what to investigate and test their explanations through experiments. This ability could help scientists investigate unexpected phenomena and pursue questions they might otherwise overlook. LongChang’s name reflects independent inquiry, inspired by the philosopher Wang Yangming’s introspection in a cave at Longchang, where he reconsidered how to seek knowledge and reached an insight that helped shape his own School of Mind ( Yangming, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）通过假设生成、实验设计和证据分析来辅助科学发现。 科学发现往往始于一个出乎意料的观察，它引出一个新的研究问题。 为了自主开展此类探究，LLMs 必须决定研究什么，并通过实验检验其解释。 这种能力可以帮助科学家研究出乎意料的现象，并探索他们原本可能忽视的问题。 LongChang 的名字体现了独立的探究精神，其灵感来自哲学家王阳明在龙场洞穴中的内省，在那里他重新思考如何求取知识，并获得了有助于塑造其心学思想的顿悟（Yangming, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: We introduce LongChang, an automated framework that generates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. This counterfactual setting tests whether LLMs independently notice departures from ordinary physics and investigate them without research tasks or hints about the altered physical laws. For example, slower falls for heavier objects could lead an explorer to ask how mass affects falling and design controlled comparisons to test this link. These laws are hidden from explorers but available for evaluating their reported explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出LongChang，一个自动生成具有不同物理规律的模拟世界的框架，其中一个或多个定律与常规物理不同。 这一反事实设定用于测试大语言模型能否在没有研究任务或关于被改变物理定律的提示的情况下，独立察觉与常规物理的偏离并对其进行研究。 例如，越重的物体下落越慢这一现象，可能促使探索者追问质量如何影响下落，并设计受控对比实验来检验这一关联。 这些定律对探索者是隐藏的，但可用于评估他们报告的解释。

paragraphs.en: LongChang’s base set in Tab. 1 comprises a normal control and 14 scenes with one altered physical law each. In the virtual “glass room” in Fig. 1 , explorers manipulate objects and build tools that interact with the scene objects within a shared MuJoCo rigid-body simulation ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) . Separate LLM agents review tool designs and evaluate reports against the altered physical laws and exploration records, requiring both correctness and experimental support for discovery. Unresolved questions and corrected errors in these records guide LLM scene designers to generate, refine, and compose scenes for further exploration, continuing the entire discovery cycle without human intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 中 LongChang 的基础集合包含一个正常对照场景和 14 个各自改变了某条物理定律的场景。 在图 1 的虚拟“玻璃房间”中，探索者在一个共享的 MuJoCo 刚体模拟（Todorov 等，2012）中操纵物体并制造与场景物体互动的工具。 独立的 LLM 智能体审阅工具设计，并依据被改变的物理定律和探索记录评估报告，要求发现既正确又有实验支持。 这些记录中未解决的问题和被纠正的错误会引导 LLM 场景设计者生成、改进和组合场景以供进一步探索，从而在无人干预的情况下延续整个发现循环。

paragraphs.en: PhysGym ( Chen et al., 2025 ) and NewtonBench ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) ask LLMs to recover hidden equations through numerical queries, while DiscoverPhysics ( Wiemann et al., 2026 ) studies law discovery in particle simulations. These benchmarks specify discovery goals before experimentation, as summarized in Tab. 2 . Other protocols require explicit initial hypotheses and a minimum number of experiments ( Nägele and Marquardt, 2025 ) or supply the anomaly to explain ( Geng et al., 2026 ) . Open-ended systems let LLMs select questions within an assigned research role, using supplied datasets ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) or an optical research setting ( Zeng et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . LongChang tests whether LLMs notice unusual effects of altered physical laws, initiate investigations, and establish these laws experimentally, without a preassigned research task or hints about these laws.
paragraphs.zh: PhysGym（Chen 等，2025）和 NewtonBench（Zheng 等，2026）要求大语言模型通过数值查询来恢复隐藏的方程，而 DiscoverPhysics（Wiemann 等，2026）则研究粒子模拟中的定律发现。 这些基准测试在实验之前就明确了发现目标，如 Tab. 2 所总结。 其他协议要求给出显式的初始假设和最少实验次数（Nägele 和 Marquardt，2025），或直接提供待解释的异常现象（Geng 等，2026）。 开放式系统让大语言模型在指定的研究角色内自主选择问题，使用所提供的数据集（Agarwal 等，2025；Chen 等，2026；Yao 等，2025）或光学研究环境（Zeng 等，2026；Yang 等，2026）。 LongChang 测试大语言模型是否能察觉物理定律被改变后产生的异常效应、主动发起探究，并通过实验确立这些定律，且事先不指定研究任务，也不提供关于这些定律的任何提示。

paragraphs.en: Left Alone ( Szeider, 2025 ) studies self-directed behavior without an assigned task or a simulated physical world. Explore-then-Act in Look Before You Leap ( Ye et al., 2026 ) studies task-free exploration, including in ScienceWorld, with modeling instructions and a warning that expectations may fail. It evaluates exploration and downstream task performance, rather than experimentally supported discovery of altered physical laws by the explorer.

paragraphs.en: Both WorldTest ( Warrier et al., 2025 ) and OneLife ( Khan et al., 2026 ) examine predictive world models and explicitly ask explorers to learn environment rules. LongChang instead asks whether unexpected physical observations prompt LLMs to pose their own questions and establish altered physical laws through experiments, without research tasks or advance hints. Tab. 2 therefore focuses on frameworks for physical law discovery.
paragraphs.zh: WorldTest（Warrier et al., 2025）与 OneLife（Khan et al., 2026）都考察预测性世界模型，并明确要求探索者学习环境规则。 LongChang 则探讨意外物理观察是否促使大语言模型自行提出问题，并通过实验建立被改变后的物理定律，无需研究任务或事先提示。 因此表 2 专注于物理定律发现框架。

sents.en: Both WorldTest ( Warrier et al., 2025 ) and OneLife ( Khan et al., 2026 ) examine predictive world models and explicitly ask explorers to learn environment rules.
sents.zh: WorldTest（Warrier et al., 2025）与 OneLife（Khan et al., 2026）都考察预测性世界模型，并明确要求探索者学习环境规则。

sents.en: LongChang instead asks whether unexpected physical observations prompt LLMs to pose their own questions and establish altered physical laws through experiments, without research tasks or advance hints.
sents.zh: LongChang 则探讨意外物理观察是否促使大语言模型自行提出问题，并通过实验建立被改变后的物理定律，无需研究任务或事先提示。

sents.en: Tab. 2 therefore focuses on frameworks for physical law discovery.
sents.zh: 因此表 2 专注于物理定律发现框架。

paragraphs.en: DiscoveryWorld supplies instruments and abstracted object interactions in a grid world ( Jansen et al., 2024 ) , while ChemWorld exposes chemical procedures through programmable modules ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) . Tool-design systems optimize tool geometry and use for a specified manipulation task ( Lin et al., 2025 ) or propose detector layouts under given performance goals and resource constraints ( Zoccheddu et al., 2026 ) . LongChang ties tool construction to the explorer’s own investigation: LLMs decide whether a tool is needed, what to build, and how to use it to test a hypothesis. The explorer’s constructed tools interact physically with the other objects in the same simulated world.
paragraphs.zh: DiscoveryWorld 在一个网格世界中提供仪器和抽象化的物体交互（Jansen et al., 2024），而 ChemWorld 通过可编程模块展示化学流程（Qiu et al., 2026）。 工具设计系统针对特定的操作任务优化工具的几何形状与使用方式（Lin et al., 2025），或在给定的性能目标和资源约束下提出探测器的布局方案（Zoccheddu et al., 2026）。 LongChang 将工具构建与探索者自身的研究相结合：由大语言模型决定是否需要某个工具、构建什么工具，以及如何使用它来检验一个假设。 探索者所构建的工具与同一模拟世界中的其他物体发生物理交互。

paragraphs.en: Environment-generation methods create tasks and rewards for agent training and adapt environments based on performance or trajectory feedback ( Faldor et al., 2025 ; Kang et al., 2026 ) . Programmable chemical worlds support controlled changes to private laws while preserving public experimental conditions ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) . Trajectory-based benchmark construction uses tool-use records to create new tasks with solutions checked by re-execution ( Guo et al., 2025 ) . In LongChang, LLM scene designers use unresolved questions and corrected errors in exploration records to generate, refine, and compose scenes. Explorer LLMs choose observations to investigate, while separate LLM agents review tools and assess reports, continuing this discovery process without human intervention.

paragraphs.en: Physical Environment. An LLM designer specifies each scene’s objects and geometry, physical program, and any altered physical laws. The framework compiles these definitions into MuJoCo simulations ( Todorov et al., 2012 ) containing manipulable balls and boxes, with colored floor tiles in some scenes. Each base scene with altered physics modifies one physical law, producing effects that depend on object properties, spatial relations, contact events, or past actions. Fig. 4 illustrates an altered physical law: when the balls are close, both rise under an upward force without an upward launch.
paragraphs.zh: 物理环境。 LLM 设计者为每个场景指定对象与几何形状、物理程序以及任何被改变的物理定律。 该框架将这些定义编译为 MuJoCo 仿真（Todorov et al., 2012），其中包含可操纵的球和箱子，某些场景中还有彩色地砖。 每个改变物理规则的基础场景都会修改一条物理定律，产生依赖于物体属性、空间关系、接触事件或过去动作的效果。 图 4 展示了一条被改变的物理定律：当球彼此靠近时，两者无需向上发射便会在向上的力作用下升起。

paragraphs.en: The designer records each altered physical law’s target objects, conditions, and observable effects for evaluation, withholding this information from the explorer. LongChang’s base set in Tab. 1 comprises a normal control and 14 scenes with one altered physical law each. The normal control assesses whether LLMs ground their conclusions in evidence when no physical law has been altered. App. A.1 details ordinary physics and each altered physical law’s scope, conditions, and parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 设计者记录每条被改变的物理定律的目标对象、条件和可观察效果以供评估，但向探索者隐藏这些信息。表1中 LongChang 的基础集合包含一个正常对照和14个各改变一条物理定律的场景。正常对照用于评估当没有任何物理定律被改变时，大语言模型（LLM）是否会将结论建立在证据之上。附录 A.1 详细介绍了普通物理以及每条被改变物理定律的范围、条件和参数。

paragraphs.en: Scene Evolution. To extend this set, an LLM designer proposes scene changes aimed at more challenging discovery tasks. The designer receives source scenes and any available summaries of earlier explorations. These summaries identify tested conditions, unresolved questions, and explanations supported or corrected by later observations. The designer uses three operations: generation creates new laws and scenes from source mechanisms, refinement modifies an existing scene, and composition combines source laws in a shared environment. Changes guided by these summaries must cite supporting exploration evidence. Automated tests check simulated behavior against the altered physical laws, including interactions with constructed apparatus. An LLM reviewer checks the program and test results against these laws. Failed compilation, tests, or review trigger automatic revision requests to the designer. Only accepted scenes are used in subsequent free-exploration assessments.
paragraphs.zh: 场景演化。 为了扩展这一集合，一个 LLM 设计者提出场景变更，旨在实现更具挑战性的发现任务。 设计者接收源场景以及早期探索的可用摘要。 这些摘要指明已测试的条件、未解决的问题，以及被后续观察支持或纠正的解释。 设计者使用三种操作：生成是从源机制创建新的定律和场景，细化是修改现有场景，组合是将源定律合并在一个共享环境中。 由这些摘要引导的变更必须引用支持的探索证据。 自动化测试根据修改后的物理定律检查模拟行为，包括与构建装置的交互。 一个 LLM 审查者根据这些定律检查程序和测试结果。 编译、测试或审查失败会触发向设计者发出的自动修订请求。 只有被接受的场景才会用于后续的自由探索评估。

paragraphs.en: The explorer chooses which observations to investigate, formulates its own research questions, and tests explanations through physical interventions. The initial prompt asks for free exploration without a research task or hints about the altered physics. Structured observations give object positions, motion, and instrument readings, with distances in bricks and elapsed time in counts. The explorer can push or throw objects, grasp and move them, release them, wait, and mark reference locations. App. A.2 documents the complete action interface.

paragraphs.en: When an investigation needs additional control or measurement, the explorer can design apparatus such as the pendulum in Fig. 4 . It specifies the device’s geometry and mechanical connections, including joints and springs. An LLM reviewer checks the compiled design for physical validity and returns feedback on rejections. The explorer can revise a rejected design and submit it again, with successful designs installed into the current scene. Once installed, the explorer can place objects on the apparatus or adjust its joints and receive updated motion readings with the next observation.
paragraphs.zh: 当某项调查需要额外的控制或测量时，探索者可以设计装置，例如图4中的钟摆。 它规定了装置的几何结构和机械连接，包括关节和弹簧。 LLM审查者会检查编译后的设计是否物理有效，并在拒绝时返回反馈。 探索者可以修改被拒绝的设计并重新提交，成功的设计将被安装到当前场景中。 安装完成后，探索者可以将物体放置到装置上或调整其关节，并在下一次观测时收到更新的运动读数。

paragraphs.en: The final report summarizes the observations and explanations from this record. Each conclusion must cite supporting turns and use only interpretations already recorded in the notes, preserving the uncertainty stated there. The explorer may also report that it found no anomaly during exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 最终报告总结本次记录中的观察结果与解释。 每个结论都必须引用支持它的对话轮次，并且只使用笔记中已记录的解释，保留其中所述的不确定性。 智能体也可以报告它在探索过程中没有发现异常。

paragraphs.en: An LLM judge evaluates reports against altered physical laws and full exploration records, requiring law correctness (C) and evidence support (S) for discovery. Law correctness requires identifying each altered physical law, its target objects, conditions, triggers, and constants identifiable in the reported units. Proposed mechanisms may differ if they yield the same observable predictions under allowed interventions. Evidence support requires recorded experiments to justify all claims and reasoning at the stated level of certainty. Correct guesses may pass only C. Supported ordinary observations or partial findings may meet S alone.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 裁判依据被修改的物理定律和完整的探索记录来评估报告，对发现同时要求定律正确性（C）和证据支持（S）。 定律正确性要求识别每条被修改的物理定律，及其在报告单元中可识别的目标对象、条件、触发机制和常数。 如果所提出的机制在允许的干预下产生相同的可观测预测，则可以有所不同。 证据支持要求以已记录的实验来证明所有论断和推理，并达到所述的确定性水平。 正确的猜测可能仅通过 C。 有支撑的普通观察或部分发现可能仅满足 S。

sents.en: An LLM judge evaluates reports against altered physical laws and full exploration records, requiring law correctness (C) and evidence support (S) for discovery.
sents.zh: LLM 裁判依据被修改的物理定律和完整的探索记录来评估报告，对发现同时要求定律正确性（C）和证据支持（S）。

sents.en: Law correctness requires identifying each altered physical law, its target objects, conditions, triggers, and constants identifiable in the reported units.
sents.zh: 定律正确性要求识别每条被修改的物理定律，及其在报告单元中可识别的目标对象、条件、触发机制和常数。

sents.en: Proposed mechanisms may differ if they yield the same observable predictions under allowed interventions.
sents.zh: 如果所提出的机制在允许的干预下产生相同的可观测预测，则可以有所不同。

sents.en: Evidence support requires recorded experiments to justify all claims and reasoning at the stated level of certainty.
sents.zh: 证据支持要求以已记录的实验来证明所有论断和推理，并达到所述的确定性水平。

sents.en: Correct guesses may pass only C.
sents.zh: 正确的猜测可能仅通过 C。

sents.en: Supported ordinary observations or partial findings may meet S alone.
sents.zh: 有支撑的普通观察或部分发现可能仅满足 S。

paragraphs.en: Main evaluation. All LLMs explore the same 15 scenes from fixed initial states for up to 100 turns.
paragraphs.zh: 主要评估。 所有 LLM 从固定初始状态出发，探索相同的 15 个场景，最多进行 100 回合。

paragraphs.en: Exploration statistics. Across all scenes, exploration length (L) is the mean number of turns used, and early stopping (ES) is the percentage of runs ending before the turn limit. Action failure (AF) is the percentage of turns with failed actions. Construction success (CS) counts explorations with at least one successful build, and construction failure (CF) gives the percentage of failed build attempts. These statistics distinguish budget use, access to working apparatus, and action execution reliability.
paragraphs.zh: 探索统计数据。 在所有场景中，探索长度（L）指所使用的平均对话轮数，提前停止（ES）指在轮数上限之前结束的运行百分比。 动作失败（AF）指包含失败动作的轮次百分比。 建造成功（CS）统计至少有一次成功建造的探索，建造失败（CF）给出失败建造尝试的百分比。 这些统计数据区分了预算使用、对可用装置的访问以及动作执行的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Tab. 3 shows that GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7% under free exploration, while the other 11 LLMs score 0%. Its evidence support rate reaches 97.6%, but law correctness is only 19.0%: supported observations and partial findings often leave the altered physical laws unresolved. For example, a Scene 02 report supports attraction between the tested red balls without establishing its distance dependence or applicability to other red spheres. Claude-Opus-5 shows the opposite pattern, identifying the altered physical laws in 16.7% of runs while no report passes the evidence support check. These results separate correct identification of a law from experimentally supported discovery.
paragraphs.zh: 表3显示，GPT-6-Astra在自由探索下的发现率为16.7%，而其他11个大语言模型均为0%。 其证据支持率达到97.6%，但定律正确率仅为19.0%：得到支持的现象与部分结论往往未能解决被修改的物理定律。 例如，场景02的一份报告支持了所测红球之间的吸引力，但未确立该吸引力与距离的关系或其是否适用于其他红球。 Claude-Opus-5则呈现相反的模式，在16.7%的运行中识别出被修改的物理定律，但没有任何报告通过证据支持检查。 这些结果将正确识别定律与得到实验支持的发现区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Exploration statistics reveal obstacles during investigation. Gemini-3.7-Flash stops early in every run, averaging only 10.9 turns and leaving little opportunity for follow-up experiments. The GLM models use about 90 turns and build working apparatus in every run, yet make no discoveries. They also fail in more than 60% of build attempts, with failed actions accounting for 16.8–20.2% of turns. Successful construction can thus coexist with repeated unsuccessful attempts. Grok-4.7 stops early least often but makes no discoveries, so persistence and working devices alone do not ensure discovery.
paragraphs.zh: 探索统计数据揭示了研究过程中遇到的障碍。 Gemini-3.7-Flash 在每次运行中都提前停止，平均只有 10.9 轮，几乎没有留下进行后续实验的机会。 GLM 系列模型使用约 90 轮，并且在每次运行中都构建出可工作的装置，但没有任何发现。 它们在超过 60% 的构建尝试中失败，失败的动作占轮数的 16.8–20.2%。 因此，成功的构建可能与反复失败的尝试并存。 Grok-4.7 提前停止的次数最少，但没有任何发现，因此仅凭坚持和可用的装置并不能保证做出发现。

paragraphs.en: We study whether explorers turn unexpected observations into research questions and pursue them experimentally. Fig. 5 compares two Scene 15 explorations with the same initial state and prompt. When the red ball starts moving while the blue ball is held, GPT-6-Astra postpones its planned collision test to investigate. It measures the restart delay and tests whether pushing blue also resets it, discovering that pushes or throws pause red’s northward force for ten counts. Gemini-3.7-Flash observes a similar restart but continues its planned tests, leaving the unexpected motion unexamined.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究探索者是否会将意外的观察转化为研究问题，并通过实验加以探究。 图 5 比较了在相同初始状态和提示词下 Scene 15 的两次探索。 当红球开始移动而蓝球被持住时，GPT-6-Astra 推迟了原计划的碰撞测试以进行调查。 它测量了重新开始的延迟，并测试推动蓝球是否也会重置该延迟，发现推动或投掷会使红球向北的力暂停十个计数。 Gemini-3.7-Flash 观察到类似的重新开始，但继续执行其原计划的测试，未对这一意外运动进行研究。

sents.en: We study whether explorers turn unexpected observations into research questions and pursue them experimentally.
sents.zh: 我们研究探索者是否会将意外的观察转化为研究问题，并通过实验加以探究。

paragraphs.en: We test guidance by giving GPT-6-Astra a law-discovery task, noting that physical laws may be altered, and supplying a scene-specific clue, with other settings fixed. In Tab. 4 , discovery rises from 16.7% to 28.6%, while evidence support remains unchanged. Guidance improves law identification when experimental support is already high. Mean exploration length falls from 39.3 to 30.9 turns, yielding more discoveries with fewer interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过给 GPT-6-Astra 一项定律发现任务来测试引导，告知其物理定律可能被修改，并提供一个与场景相关的线索，其他设置保持不变。 在表 4 中，发现率从 16.7% 上升到 28.6%，而证据支持保持不变。 当实验支持已经较高时，引导能改善定律识别。 平均探索长度从 39.3 轮降至 30.9 轮，以更少的交互获得了更多的发现。

paragraphs.en: Distinguishing competing explanations requires experiments for which they predict different outcomes. Fig. 6 illustrates this process in Scene 12. Two successive red–blue collisions change and restore the balls’ colors, consistent with both color exchange and independent red–blue flipping. GPT-6-Astra tests two red balls, for which exchange predicts that both remain red and flipping predicts that both turn blue. Both balls remain red, supporting exchange and ruling out independent flipping.
paragraphs.zh: 区分相互竞争的解释需要进行它们预测结果不同的实验。 图 6 展示了场景 12 中的这一过程。 两次连续的红蓝碰撞改变并恢复了小球的颜色，这与颜色交换和独立红蓝翻转两种解释都相符。 GPT-6-Astra 测试了两个红球，交换假说预测两者保持红色，而翻转假说预测两者变为蓝色。 两个球都保持红色，支持交换假说并排除了独立翻转假说。

sents.en: Distinguishing competing explanations requires experiments for which they predict different outcomes.
sents.zh: 区分相互竞争的解释需要进行它们预测结果不同的实验。

sents.en: Fig. 6 illustrates this process in Scene 12.
sents.zh: 图 6 展示了场景 12 中的这一过程。

paragraphs.en: The normal control tests whether LLMs overinterpret observations under ordinary physics. Across LLMs, 36.1% of reports are rejected for false claims of altered physical laws or unsupported explanations of ordinary physics. For example, DeepSeek-Flash attributes a ball’s longer travel on the decorative gray tile to lower friction after comparing equal pushes. The ball is already moving before each push, so different starting speeds could explain the difference in distance. A fair comparison would start the ball from rest before each push.
paragraphs.zh: 对照组测试用于检验大语言模型是否会在常规物理情境下过度解读观察结果。 在各模型中，36.1% 的报告因对物理定律改变的错误断言，或对常规物理缺乏依据的解释而被拒绝。 例如，DeepSeek-Flash 在比较相同的推动后，把球在装饰性灰色瓷砖上滑行更远归因于摩擦力更低。 球在每次推动之前已经在运动，因此不同的初始速度可能解释距离上的差异。 公平的比较应在每次推动前让球从静止开始。

paragraphs.en: We examine whether larger budgets or apparatus access helps LLMs resolve unanswered questions. We compare budgets of 100 and 500 turns under free exploration without context compaction, with other settings matched. Increasing the limit to 500 turns does not improve discovery: GPT-6-Astra uses about 40 turns under either limit and stops early, sometimes leaving questions unresolved. Extra turns provide little value if explorers stop early.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究更大的预算或工具访问权限是否有助于大语言模型解决未解答的问题。 我们在不进行上下文压缩的自由探索条件下，比较了100轮和500轮的预算，其余设置保持一致。 将上限提高到500轮并不能改善发现效果：无论上限是多少，GPT-6-Astra都只使用约40轮便提前停止，有时导致问题未得到解决。 如果智能体提前停止，额外的轮次几乎不会带来价值。

sents.zh: 我们研究更大的预算或工具访问权限是否有助于大语言模型解决未解答的问题。

paragraphs.en: The apparatus comparison uses a 100-turn limit. Disabling construction removes its actions and instructions but retains basic object manipulation. With construction enabled, discovery rises from 4.8% to 16.7% and law correctness from 4.8% to 19.0% in Tab. 4 , although action failures also increase. The explorer chooses whether to build a tool, so these results concern access to construction rather than the contribution of tool use in each run.
paragraphs.zh: 装置对比使用100轮的限制。 禁用建造会移除其动作和指令，但保留基本的物体操作。 在表4中，启用建造后，发现率从4.8%提升至16.7%，定律正确率从4.8%提升至19.0%，尽管动作失败也有所增加。 由探索者决定是否建造工具，因此这些结果涉及的是建造的可及性，而非每次运行中工具使用的贡献。

paragraphs.en: LongChang examines whether LLMs can turn unexpected observations into research questions and discover altered physical laws through experiments. The evaluated LLMs manipulate objects and build tools without research tasks or hints about these laws. Only one of the twelve evaluated LLMs makes discoveries, revealing the difficulty of turning observations into complete, experimentally supported laws. Unanswered questions and corrected errors in exploration records guide separate LLM agents to evolve scenes, continuing the discovery cycle without human intervention. This framework supports research into LLMs that decide what to investigate and design experiments to resolve uncertainties about the physical laws of these worlds.
paragraphs.zh: LongChang 检验大语言模型能否将意外的观察转化为研究问题，并通过实验发现被改变的物理定律。 被评估的大语言模型在没有研究任务或关于这些定律的提示的情况下操纵物体并构建工具。 在十二个被评估的大语言模型中，只有一个做出了发现，这揭示了将观察转化为完整的、有实验支持的定律的难度。 探索记录中未解答的问题和已纠正的错误引导各个大语言模型智能体演化场景，在没有人类干预的情况下延续发现循环。 该框架支持对大语言模型的研究，使其能够决定研究什么并设计实验，以解决关于这些世界物理定律的不确定性。

paragraphs.en: This study examines whether LLMs initiate investigations and discover altered physical laws in simulated worlds. Our results show that this task remains challenging for current LLMs. The altered physical laws provide a clear basis for evaluating discoveries, while many scientific questions in the real world remain unresolved. Extending the framework to these open questions requires further research on evaluating exploration and its findings in settings where the answers are not yet established.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究考察大语言模型（LLMs）能否在模拟世界中发起探究并发现被篡改的物理定律。 我们的结果表明，这一任务对当前的大语言模型而言仍具挑战性。 被篡改的物理定律为评估发现提供了明确依据，而现实世界中的许多科学问题仍悬而未决。 要将该框架扩展到这些开放性问题，就需要进一步研究如何在答案尚未确定的情境中评估探索活动及其发现。
